mutation_planner.single_trait.inheritanc:
Spell/ability inheritance: {percent:.1f}% chance per breeding (stim {stim}), 50/50 parent pick.

Strategy: Breed a carrier with any cat. If both parents have the ability, either can pass it.

Visual mutations: 80% chance all parts inherited. Mutated part favored at {percent:.1f}% (stim {stim}).

Strategy: Breed a carrier with any cat. The offspring has a high chance of inheriting the mutated body part(s) from the carrier parent.

Passive/disorder inheritance: {percent:.1f}% chance per breeding (stim {stim}), 50/50 parent pick.
If both parents carry it: ~{percent:.1f}% chance, but either parent can pass it.
Disorders specifically: 15% flat chance from each parent.

Strategy: Pair two carriers together for the best odds. If only one carrier exists, breed them and hope for inheritance, then breed carriers from the next generation together.

perfect_planner.description: Build a staged plan for pushing toward full 7-base-stat lines without family breeding. Use Max inbreeding risk = 0 to force fully clean plans.
perfect_planner.detail.summary.excluded: Excluded Cats  |  {count} cats excluded from planner calculations
perfect_planner.detail.summary.excluded_: Excluded cats are hidden from the Perfect 7 Planner calculations.
perfect_planner.detail.summary_idle: Select a stage to see the plan details.
perfect_planner.stage1.action.children: Keep the strongest son and daughter if possible. Do not reuse siblings together.
perfect_planner.stage1.action.rotate: Stay on this pair until the line stops improving, then use the Stage 3 outcross.
perfect_planner.stage1.action.why_intro: Fast foundation pair for a perfect-7 line. Projected 7+ coverage: {coverage:.1f}/7 at stimulation {stim}. Breakpoint: {headline}.
perfect_planner.stage1.details: Best unrelated pairs to start pushing 7s immediately
perfect_planner.stage1.note.disjoint: Foundation pairs are disjoint so you can work multiple lines at once.
perfect_planner.stage1.note.risk_cap: Max inbreeding risk is enforced before a pair can appear here.
perfect_planner.stage1.summary: Start with {count} unrelated foundation pairs. These are the fastest low-risk lines for reaching full 7-base-stat coverage.
perfect_planner.stage1.title: Stage 1
perfect_planner.stage2.action.children: Move Pair {index} sons and daughters into different rooms from each other and from {parent_a} / {parent_b} once they mature.
perfect_planner.stage2.action.rotate: Choose one keeper line per sex, then hold the backups aside for future outcrosses.
perfect_planner.stage2.action.title: Separate Pair {index} offspring
perfect_planner.stage2.action.why: Keeping sons and daughters apart preserves multiple clean branches instead of collapsing into sibling breeding.
perfect_planner.stage2.details: Room guidance to avoid collapsing the plan into sibling loops
perfect_planner.stage2.note.guidance: This stage is the child-separation guidance from issue #19.
perfect_planner.stage2.note.keep_one: If you only keep one kitten, keep the one that raises the lowest missing stat.
perfect_planner.stage2.summary: Separate offspring by line and sex. The planner assumes you will keep clean branches available for the next generation instead of breeding within one family.
perfect_planner.stage2.title: Stage 2
perfect_planner.stage3.action.defer_chil: Keep the best backup kitten alive and wait for an unrelated stray or future outcross.
perfect_planner.stage3.action.defer_rota: Bring in a stray/unrelated breeder with 7s in {stats}.
perfect_planner.stage3.action.defer_why: No clean outcross in the current roster covers the missing stats under the active risk cap.
perfect_planner.stage3.action.rotation_c: Promote the kitten that keeps the old locked stats while adding the missing stat coverage.
perfect_planner.stage3.action.rotation_r: Swap once the current line stops improving or when siblings would be your next obvious match.
perfect_planner.stage3.action.rotation_w: Use this {source} outcross when Pair {index} stalls on {stats}. It covers missing 7-stats without falling back to family breeding. Projected 7+ coverage: {coverage:.1f}/7 at stimulation {stim}. Breakpoint: {headline}.
perfect_planner.stage3.details: When and why to outcross instead of breeding inward
perfect_planner.stage3.goal: Rotate partners before the line stalls
perfect_planner.stage3.note.coverage: Rotation advice is based on the missing 7-stat coverage from each foundation pair.
perfect_planner.stage3.note.wait_founder: If no candidate appears, the roster is telling you to wait for a cleaner founder.
perfect_planner.stage3.summary: Rotate into unrelated or lower-risk partners when a line is missing specific 7s. This is the long-term maintenance step from issue #26.
perfect_planner.stage3.title: Stage 3
perfect_planner.stage4.action.finish_chi: Keep one opposite-sex backup in a different room so the finished line survives bad rolls.
perfect_planner.stage4.action.finish_rot: Retire the weaker branch once the new keeper strictly improves the missing stats.
perfect_planner.stage4.action.finish_tit: Finish Pair {index} through a keeper outcross
perfect_planner.stage4.action.finish_why: Once a keeper from this line is close to all 7s, use the Stage 3 rotation target rather than breeding back into siblings or parents.
perfect_planner.stage4.action.maintain_c: Keep a primary breeder and a backup of the opposite sex in separate rooms.
perfect_planner.stage4.action.maintain_r: Only bring in an unrelated stray if you need redundancy or the risk cap tightens.
perfect_planner.stage4.action.maintain_w: This line already covers every target stat. The goal shifts from climbing to preserving.
perfect_planner.stage4.details: How to convert the strongest keeper lines into durable perfect cats
perfect_planner.stage4.goal: Maintain and finish the strongest lines
perfect_planner.stage4.note.goal: The planner is optimizing toward perfect 7-base-stat coverage, not short-term room fill.
perfect_planner.stage4.note.risk_zero: Set Max inbreeding risk to 0 for the cleanest possible plan.
perfect_planner.stage4.summary: Use the strongest keepers to finish the line, then preserve it with unrelated backups instead of letting the plan collapse into inbred maintenance.
perfect_planner.stage4.title: Stage 4
